answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a slashable stake before it can earn or grade. Creating one account is cheap, like picking up a marble, but creating ten thousand bonded accounts ties up real capital that is burned on proven fraud. Honest work grows slowly, layer by layer like a pearl around a kernel of verified history, while an attacker must fund every fake separately and loses the whole stake when peer attestations expose coordinated cheating.
